4 A student investigates the rate at which the temperature of water inside a beaker increases when
the water is heated.
Plan an experiment to investigate how one variable affects the rate at which the temperature of
the water increases.
The apparatus available includes:
• a selection of beakers
• an electrical water heater
• a supply of water.
In your plan:
• state the one variable you have chosen to investigate
• name any other apparatus needed
• give a brief description of the method, including what you will measure
• state the key variables to be kept constant
• draw a table, with column headings, to show how to display the readings (you are not
required to enter any readings in the table)
• explain how to use the readings to reach a conclusion.
